# Data Directory

This directory is used to store:
- Sample datasets for local development and testing
- Simulated transaction data files
- Output from batch processing jobs

## Datasets

For model training, download the [Kaggle Credit Card Fraud Detection dataset](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/mlg-ulb/creditcardfraud) and place it here as `creditcard.csv`.

## Generated Files

When running the Kafka producer simulation, generated transaction records can be saved here for offline analysis.
